purpose: Teach: 勝てる/そろえ/置け/絞ら/読み直し/在り方/実装/低減

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、市場に勝てる商品を作ったぞ
lines.en: Your father had a gift for creating products that could beat the competition.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the memory. Steady, measured pace. Slight lift on the recollection — not boastful, just factual acknowledgment. Warm but unrushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員をそろえる名手でした
lines.en: Yes. He had a talent for bringing together the right people.
lines.style: Respectful agreement, eyes reflecting inward. Formal but not distant. Each word carries equal weight — honoring the memory without ornament. Steady breath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員が私物を置ける棚をご用意なさった
lines.en: Your father always made sure there was space for people to keep their things. Small gesture, but he thought of those details.
lines.style: Voice softens on the recollection. Slight catch of emotion held carefully underneath. Slower pace — lingering on the kindness of the memory. Trailing off gently.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは予算を絞らせる経営者でした
lines.en: Yes. He was rigorous about stewardship — about not wasting resources.
lines.style: Measured and contemplative. A note of quiet respect for the discipline. Not cold — appreciative of the principle. Deliberate pacing, each phrase distinct.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、契約書を読み直しする習慣をお持ちだった
lines.en: Your father made it a habit to read contracts carefully, more than once. He didn't take shortcuts with the details.
lines.style: Voice carries deep respect. Slower rhythm — almost reverent. Slight emphasis on the thoroughness, not as criticism but as testament. Fades gently at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの会社の在り方、引き継いでおります
lines.en: Yes. The way he built the company — those principles — I've carried them forward.
lines.style: Firm but not hard. Voice settles into conviction. Each phrase grounded. A promise spoken quietly, to the memory and to himself. No doubt in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、新システムを早く実装される方だった
lines.en: Your father had a reputation for moving quickly when something needed to be done. He didn't hesitate when the time was right.
lines.style: Admiration in the tone. Slightly quicker pace than before — honoring his decisiveness. Warm, almost approving. Trailing off into reflection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが進められた低減策、続けております
lines.en: Yes. The cost-reduction measures he initiated — I've kept them in place. That legacy continues.
lines.style: Voice closes with quiet finality and gentleness. Steady, composed. A benediction rather than a statement. This is the last word on the matter, but not a closing door — a bridge carried forward.
